reason: Both ask for the same $11,500 with the same honest evidence, and both leave out the claim that every publisher pays $12,000, which the facts don't support. A puts the number up front and ends with "if that works for you, I'm ready to get started," so I could agree with a one-line reply. B's "before I say yes" and its request for a call add a little friction, though B does mention the four months of work each book takes.
